checksum_strategy: Full SHA-256 of every raw file, streamed in 1 MiB blocks.
license_note: NFL Big Data Bowl 2026 competition data, used under the competition's data-use terms for development and portfolio demonstration. Raw and processed data are not committed.

checks.description: Input rows with a null game_id or play_id; they are dropped and counted.
checks.name: input_rows_without_play_key

checks.description: Plays with a null in a required input column (nfl_id, frame_id, play_direction, player_side, player_role, player_to_predict, x, y, num_frames_output).
checks.name: input_required_nulls

checks.description: Plays with more than one row for the same (nfl_id, frame_id).
checks.name: input_duplicate_frame_rows

checks.description: play_direction is not 'left' or 'right'.
checks.name: input_unknown_play_direction

checks.description: player_side outside ['Offense', 'Defense'].
checks.name: input_unknown_player_side

checks.description: player_role outside ['Passer', 'Targeted Receiver', 'Other Route Runner', 'Defensive Coverage'].
checks.name: input_unknown_player_role

checks.description: Plays with NaN or infinite x, y, s, a, dir, or o.
checks.name: input_non_finite_values

checks.description: dir or o outside [0, 360] degrees.
checks.name: input_angle_out_of_range

checks.description: s or a below zero.
checks.name: input_negative_speed_or_acceleration

checks.description: Share of input rows with null s, a, dir, o.
checks.name: input_kinematic_null_rate

checks.description: Observed rows with x outside [0, 120] or y outside [0, 53.33]. Kept: players can be out of bounds.
checks.name: input_positions_outside_field

checks.description: Plays where a per-play value (play_direction, absolute_yardline_number, num_frames_output, ball_land_x, ball_land_y) varies across rows.
checks.name: input_inconsistent_play_constants

checks.description: Plays where a player's name, position, side, role, or prediction flag changes between frames.
checks.name: input_unstable_player_identity

checks.description: Plays whose frame_id values are not a gap-free run.
checks.name: input_non_contiguous_frames

checks.description: Plays where some player is missing from some observed frames.
checks.name: input_incomplete_player_frames

checks.description: Plays without exactly one Passer. Kept; excluded from the development subset.
checks.name: input_passer_count

checks.description: Plays with no offensive or no defensive player. Kept; excluded from the development subset.
checks.name: input_missing_side

checks.description: Plays whose ball_land_x/y lies outside the field rectangle (for example passes thrown out of bounds).
checks.name: ball_landing_outside_field

checks.description: Supplementary rows sharing a (game_id, play_id); the join would be ambiguous.
checks.name: supplementary_duplicate_keys

checks.description: Tracked plays with no supplementary row.
checks.name: supplementary_missing_for_tracking

checks.description: Supplementary rows with no tracking in the train files; not used.
checks.name: supplementary_without_tracking

checks.description: Null counts per supplementary column for tracked plays. Nulls are kept as null, never filled.
checks.name: supplementary_optional_nulls

checks.description: Plays where absolute_yardline_number (rotated to the canonical frame) disagrees with the line of scrimmage implied by yardline_side / yardline_number / possession_team.
checks.name: line_of_scrimmage_consistency

checks.description: Plays with duplicate (nfl_id, frame_id) rows in the output files.
checks.name: output_duplicate_frame_rows

checks.description: Output rows with null, NaN, or infinite x/y.
checks.name: output_non_finite_positions

checks.description: Future rows with x outside [0, 120] or y outside [0, 53.33]. Kept: players can run out of bounds after the throw.
checks.name: output_positions_outside_field

checks.description: Input plays with no output (future) rows.
checks.name: output_missing_for_input

checks.description: Output plays with no input rows; ignored.
checks.name: output_without_input

checks.description: Plays where a future trajectory is not exactly frames 1..num_frames_output.
checks.name: output_frames_match_num_frames_output

checks.description: Plays where output players differ from input players flagged player_to_predict.
checks.name: output_players_match_player_to_predict

checks.description: Future frame 1 should follow the last observed frame by one 0.1 s step. Plays where a player's displacement across that boundary exceeds 3.0 yd.
checks.name: output_continues_observed_sequence
